package_digest_rule: sha256 over the UTF-8 text formed by one line per package_files entry, '<path> <sha256>\n', sorted by path. manifest.json and index.json are outside the package and are never hashed into it.
independence_boundary: The reference verifier is author-produced and is not independent verification. A second implementation is implementation diversity, not independence. L3_INDEPENDENT_RECOMPUTATION requires a second implementation maintained outside REMORA, run by an external operator, importing neither REMORA code nor this verifier (interop-result-v1).
